alt: 2026 Audi Q9 SUV photographed from the right-front quarter in daylight, showing the massive Singleframe grille, four-ring badge, and — crucially — perfectly ordinary conventional door handles on a $90,000 car
story: Audi's CEO Gernot Döllner drove the Q9 prototype once with its piezoelectric winglet door handles — which would open via a touch-sensitive flap instead of a conventional lever — decided they were 'worse than a conventional door handle', and ordered an emergency 45-week redesign to put regular door handles back on their upcoming $90,000 flagship SUV, a process that normally takes two years.
why_funny: Audi's proudest engineering achievement for its most expensive SUV is that it successfully put back the thing it spent years trying to remove.
